behaviour.title: Re-running will duplicate rows, despite the node name
behaviour.detail: "Upsert into Notion" is named as an update or upsert but runs operation create, which always writes a new record. A redelivered webhook, a manual retry or an overlapping scheduled run therefore creates a second copy. Add a unique key on the destination, or switch the operation, before you rely on it.

bindings.detail: The dropdown shows "Archives", which is a placeholder label with no value behind it - the node looks configured and is not. Open Archive Copy to Google Drive and pick the real folderId from the list.

behaviour.title: Clear the pinned sample data before going live
behaviour.detail: "Daily Schedule" carries pinned sample data, which is what lets the workflow run end to end before you have wired anything up. While it is pinned, a manual execution reads the sample and never calls the real service - so the run succeeds and proves nothing about your setup. Unpin it once the credentials and bindings are in place.
